taxonomic_note: Legacy Master Plant Pool name Lesquerella recurvata normalized to current accepted Physaria recurvata.
look_here_first: Slender yellow-flowered bladderpod distinguished by recurved fruiting structures and inflated capsules.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local legacy source; Kew and ITIS accept Physaria recurvata and explicitly list Lesquerella recurvata as synonym.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; broader exact-county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Brassicaceae bladderpod group: 4-petaled yellow flowers, stellate hairs common, and inflated silicles/capsules; habit, hair density, pedicel posture, and fruit shape are important for ID.
best_field_traits: fruiting pedicels or fruits characteristically recurved
dry prairie or rocky open habitat
morphology_keys.comparison_training: The name is the memory cue: recurvata = recurved. Look for backward-curving fruiting posture rather than the straighter fruit stalks of P. gracilis.
